case_number: 2023 INSC 219; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 219 OF 2023 (@ SLP(C) NO. 7645 OF 2018)
summary: Disciplinary dismissal of CRPF constable for misconduct while intoxicated; insubordination and threats to superiors; High Court reinstated on grounds of 'less heinous' offence under CRPF Act, s.10; Supreme Court reverses: s.10 classification for sentencing, not departmental proceedings; misconduct prejudicial to discipline; penalty not disproportionate; reinstatement improper.
legal_provisions_cited: Union of India Vs. Ram Karan; (2022) 1 SCC 373
Commandant, 22nd Battalion, CRPF Vs. Surinder Kumar; (2011) 10 SCC 244
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; dismissal from service reinstated.
